supplement.evidence: Genotype frequencies and sample sizes per site/phenotype cohort are fully reported in Table 1 and Figure 3/4 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study performed whole-genome sequencing on 498 Anopheles arabiensis specimens collected across five regions in Kenya between 2006 and 2021. Mosquitoes were phenotyped using CDC bottle bioassays with deltamethrin, alpha-cypermethrin, and pirimiphos-methyl. Vgsc L995F was detected in Turkana at frequencies of 13% to 44% and significantly associated with survival in alpha-cypermethrin bioassays. Copy number variants at Ace-1, Cyp6aa1, and Cyp9k1 were also mapped and tested for association with bioassay phenotypes.
